The '''Mission to Forscan VI''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] mission undertaken during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Background==
For the first year of the Clone Wars, the settlers of [[Forscan VI]] were able to remain neutral in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning conflict. However, in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] began to establish a training facility on the planet.<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />

Resisting occupation, the settlers immediately requested assistance from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], who contacted the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Deciding to send Jedi covertly, Knights [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were dispatched.<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />

==The Mission==
With a mandate from the Jedi Council dictating that they were not to reveal their presence to the settlers of Forscan, the two Jedi began to move around the countryside. Skywalker rashly attempted to cross through the mountains of the planet, even though Kenobi deemed them impassable.<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />

While managing to take out several of the Separatists, the duo was recalled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to deal with the pressing [[JK-13 security droid|"Jedi Killer"]] crisis.<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />
